milestones.title: The site collector (48.2-09) signs the live feed and the view names each item's signer beside the operator-signed export
The authorizing official accepts the residual risk, or a signer outside OpenBao is designed

remediation: The site collector signs the live site evidence feed with the OpenBao Transit key site-evidence, so facts about OpenBao (its seal status among them) are signed by the system they describe. The weekly operator-signed site evidence export (48-02) stays the independent check, and the Compliance view names the signer of each item. The authorizing official accepts the residual risk, or a signer outside OpenBao is designed. Source: .planning/phases/48.2-live-compliance-evidence-in-the-workbench/48.2-CONTEXT.md (D-20, D-29).
title: The live site feed is signed by a key held in OpenBao, so facts about OpenBao are signed by the system they describe
